SELECT r.churnflag,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.userregistry) AS fan_count,
  AVG(CURRENT_DATE - p.lastlogdt) AS avg_days_since_last,
  AVG(e.engrate) AS avg_eng,
  AVG(p.intconsist) AS avg_intconsist,
  AVG(CASE r.churnflag WHEN 'None' THEN 0 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'High' THEN 3 END) AS avg_risk
FROM retentionandinfluence r
JOIN engagement e ON r.retainengagepivot = e.engagereg
JOIN membershipandspending m ON e.engagememberpivot = m.memberreg
JOIN fans f ON m.memberfanpivot = f.userregistry
LEFT JOIN preferencesandsettings p ON p.preferencesmemberpivot = m.memberreg
GROUP BY r.churnflag
ORDER BY avg_risk;

SELECT r.churnflag,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.userregistry) AS fan_count,
  AVG(CURRENT_DATE - p.lastlogdt) AS avg_days_since_last,
  AVG(e.engrate) AS avg_eng,
  AVG(p.intconsist) AS avg_intconsist,
  AVG(CASE r.churnflag WHEN 'None' THEN 0 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'High' THEN 3 END) AS avg_risk
FROM retentionandinfluence r
JOIN engagement e ON r.retainengagepivot = e.engagereg
JOIN membershipandspending m ON e.engagememberpivot = m.memberreg
JOIN fans f ON m.memberfanpivot = f.userregistry
LEFT JOIN preferencesandsettings p ON p.preferencesmemberpivot = m.memberreg
GROUP BY r.churnflag
ORDER BY avg_risk;
